value: CREATE OR REPLACE SECRET inspection_store (TYPE s3, KEY_ID 'anonymous', SECRET 'anonymous', REGION 'us-east-1', ENDPOINT 's3.seaweed.home.arpa', URL_STYLE 'path', USE_SSL false)
ATTACH 's3://symmtables/' AS symmtables (TYPE iceberg, ENDPOINT 'http://iceberg.seaweed.home.arpa', AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none')

sql.value:
WITH position AS (SELECT CAST(? AS JSON) AS value, CAST(? AS VARCHAR) AS vocabulary), candidates AS (
 SELECT f.*, position.vocabulary, c.sequence, c.metrics, c.complete,
        (SELECT p.metrics FROM symmtables.symm.metric_cuts_v3 p
         WHERE p.epoch=c.epoch AND p.symbol=c.symbol AND p.sequence<c.sequence AND p.complete
         ORDER BY p.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS previous_metrics,
        (SELECT max(p.sequence) FROM symmtables.symm.metric_cuts_v3 p
         WHERE p.epoch=c.epoch AND p.symbol=c.symbol AND p.sequence<c.sequence AND p.complete) AS previous_sequence
 FROM symmtables.symm.excursion_fragments_v1 f
 JOIN symmtables.symm.metric_cuts_v3 c ON c.epoch=f.epoch AND c.symbol=f.symbol
  AND c.sequence BETWEEN f.anchor_sequence AND f.extremum_sequence
 CROSS JOIN position
 WHERE f.has_precursor AND c.complete
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM symmtables.symm.metric_cuts_v3 prior
             WHERE prior.epoch=f.epoch AND prior.symbol=f.symbol AND prior.sequence<f.anchor_sequence AND prior.complete)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM symmtables.symm.metric_cuts_v3 missing
                 WHERE missing.epoch=f.epoch AND missing.symbol=f.symbol
                  AND missing.sequence BETWEEN f.anchor_sequence AND f.extremum_sequence AND NOT missing.complete)
 AND (coalesce(position.value->>'vocabulary','') <> position.vocabulary OR (f.epoch,f.symbol,f.confirmation_sequence,c.sequence) >
 (coalesce(CAST(position.value->>'epoch' AS BIGINT),0),coalesce(position.value->>'symbol',''),
  coalesce(CAST(position.value->>'fragment' AS BIGINT),-1),coalesce(CAST(position.value->>'sequence' AS BIGINT),-1)))
 ORDER BY f.epoch,f.symbol,f.confirmation_sequence,c.sequence LIMIT 1
)
SELECT struct_pack(epoch:=epoch,symbol:=symbol,fragment:=confirmation_sequence,sequence:=sequence,vocabulary:=vocabulary) AS position,
 struct_pack(epoch:=epoch,sequence:=sequence,symbol:=symbol,complete:=complete,metrics:=metrics) AS cut,
 struct_pack(epoch:=epoch,sequence:=previous_sequence,symbol:=symbol,complete:=true,metrics:=previous_metrics) AS previous,
 struct_pack(capture:=struct_pack(session:=CAST(epoch AS VARCHAR),endpoint:='metrics'),
  cursor:=struct_pack(sequence:=sequence,record:=0),symbol:=symbol,
  event:=struct_pack(symbol:=symbol,seed:=confirmation_sequence,
   a:=struct_pack(sequence:=anchor_sequence,record:=0),b:=struct_pack(sequence:=ignition_sequence,record:=0),
   c:=struct_pack(sequence:=extremum_sequence,record:=0),d:=struct_pack(sequence:=confirmation_sequence,record:=0),excursion:=excursion)) AS observation,
 sequence=anchor_sequence AS start
FROM candidates
